page.notes: Digitiser's cover sheet from e-rara.ch (Universitätsbibliothek Basel), not part of the printed book. It shows the e-rara logo, the platform's multilingual terms-of-use text, a persistent link and the Visual Library logo. Omitted as digitiser material. The book's own title, "Amandi Polani a Polandsdorf ... de traditionibus capita quaedam", with author and "Basileae, 1593", appears here only as catalogue information, not as printed text on this page.
